name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; no address residue. Accurately describes behavior: copies a partial vertical slice of the middle status panel into the workspace at a given y_offset, one step of the multi-frame slide-up animation (panel ascends as y_offset decreases across frames). Consistent with sibling fd2_slide_panel_down_step in the same file.
purpose: Copy up to 102 (0x66) status-panel rows from src_buffer into dst_workspace starting at vertical position y_offset, clipping at screen bottom (row 200); one frame's worth of the middle-panel vertical slide.
logic_summary: row_count = 0x66; if y_offset + 0x66 would extend past screen row 199, clip row_count to 200 - y_offset. For each row 0..row_count-1: memmove(dst_workspace + 5 + (y_offset+row)*0x140, src_buffer + 0x7585 + row*0x140, 0x136). Dst and src row stride = 0x140 (320-px mode13h pitch); 0x136 (310) bytes copied per row (5-px left margin + 5-px right margin trimmed); source panel data lives at fixed offset 0x7585 within src_buffer.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_slide_panel_up_partial_step(uint y_offset, uint dst_workspace, uint src_buffer)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Vertical (y) start offset in pixels for the destination panel rows; caller passes frame_idx*0x10 + 0x5E so the panel rises by 0x10 px per frame as frame_idx decreases.
params.reason: Generic param_1 in live Ghidra; src already uses y_offset. Describes the vertical destination start position.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Linear address of the destination composite workspace (320x200 mode13h render buffer); rows written at +5 x-margin.
params.reason: Generic param_2 in live Ghidra; src already uses dst_workspace. It is the destination render buffer.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Linear base address of the source buffer holding the panel sprite bitmap; the middle-panel rows are read from base + 0x7585.
params.reason: Generic param_3 in live Ghidra; src already uses src_buffer. It is the source panel bitmap buffer.

returns.semantics: No return value; renders directly into dst_workspace.

notes: Decompiled `199 < (int)(y_offset + 0x66)` and src `(int)(y_offset + 0x66) >= 200` are equivalent (x > 199 == x >= 200); not a logic issue. No globals read/written (all data flows via the three pointer params). Both callers (fd2_open_char_status_screen intro/outro loops, fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step) confirm param_1=y_offset, param_2=dst workspace, param_3=src panel buffer, all passing y = frame*0x10 + 0x5E. src comment block is terse and accurate; plate is more detailed; the two are consistent so neither changed. Param renames deferred to Stage 2 (touch protos.h + call sites).
